responsibility: Implements out-of-line constructors, copy/assignment logic, and subtree-cloning support for Rust HIR item and declaration nodes declared in `rust-hir-item.h`. It covers generic and where-clause payloads, self and function parameters, impl and trait structures, external items, extern blocks, and other declaration-side support classes, ensuring nested types, bounds, patterns, expressions, attributes, visibility, and `Analysis::NodeMapping` data are preserved when HIR items are built or copied after lowering.
same_name_distinction: Contains the out-of-line implementations for item-side HIR classes declared in `rust-hir-item.h`, especially deep-copy, assignment, and helper logic for declaration-oriented nodes such as type parameters, where-clause items, self/function parameters, impls, and extern items. Unlike the header, it does not define the item class hierarchy itself.
